headword: {一命|いちめい}を{取|と}り{留|と}める
reading: いちめいをとりとめる
gloss: to narrowly escape death; to survive by a thread

definitions.gloss: to narrowly escape death; to survive by a thread
definitions.explanation: To barely survive a life-threatening situation such as an accident, illness, or disaster. Implies that death was very close but was narrowly avoided.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一命|いちめい}を{取|と}り{留|と}めた。
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きかった→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{運転手|うんてんしゅ}→運転手：01333_untenshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一命|いちめい}を{取|と}り{留|と}めた。
examples.english: The accident was serious, but the driver survived.

examples.japanese: ⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}{隊員|たいいん}→救急隊員：22769_kyuukyuutaiin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{迅速|じんそく}→迅速：14294_jinsoku⟧な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一命|いちめい}を{取|と}り{留|と}めること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the emergency team's swift response, the victim was able to narrowly escape death.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{一命|いちめい}→一命：11239_ichimei⟧ (one's life) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ⟦{取|と}り{留|と}める→取り留める：15466_toritomeru⟧ (to hold on to, to retain). A set expression meaning to survive a critical situation. Very common in news reports about accidents, disasters, and medical emergencies.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一命|いちめい}を{取|と}り{留|と}めた: survived (past tense, most common form)
- かろうじて{一命|いちめい}を{取|と}り{留|と}めた: barely survived
- ⟦{一命|いちめい}→一命：11239_ichimei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{取|と}り{留|と}めた→取り留める：15466_toritomeru⟧もの⟦の→の：09472_no⟧…: survived but…

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{九死|きゅうし}に{一生|いっしょう}→九死に一生：18016_kyuushiniisshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to have a narrow escape from death — a more dramatic idiom
- ⟦{命拾|いのちびろ}い→命拾い：15334_inochibiroi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a lucky escape — slightly more casual
- ⟦{危機一髪|ききいっぱつ}→危機一髪：06949_kikiippatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{助|たす}かる→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧: to be saved by a hair's breadth — emphasizes the closeness of the danger

REGISTER:
Common in written language, news reporting, and formal speech. In casual conversation, people might say ⟦{助|たす}かった→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧ (was saved) or ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{助|たす}かった→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧ instead.
